summary: Pack annonce premium (Stripe) validated end-to-end. Backend 8/8 pytest pass (/app/backend/tests/test_estimo_pack.py, xml /app/test_reports/pytest/pack.xml). GET /api/properties/6aa02db9efd8f90925a5a758/pack/status returns the exact expected shape (unlocked:false initially, price_cents:4900, currency:'eur', payments_available:true, free_retouches:1, retouches_used:1, photos:1, listings:1, last_order:{status:'pending'}); unknown pid → 404. GET /api/properties/{pid}/pack.pdf returns 402 while locked. POST /api/properties/{pid}/pack/checkout with body {return_url:'…/pack'} → 201 with order_id and checkout_url starting with https://checkout.stripe.com; return_url 'foo' → 422; unknown pid → 404. Retouch gating verified by code review in server.py:438-449 (retouch_photo returns 402 when pack.is_unlocked() is false, retouches_used>=FREE_RETOUCHES=1, and doc.status != 'done' — matches spec). END-TO-END PAYMENT executed on mobile viewport 390x844: property detail → pack-button navigates to pack screen (pack-screen, pack-offer showing '49 €', pack-pay-button) → click pack-pay-button opens Stripe Checkout (checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_…) → filled email 'test@example.com', card 4242 4242 4242 4242 / 12 34 / 123, cardholder 'Test Estimo', country France → Pay → auto-redirected to /property/6aa02db9efd8f90925a5a758/pack?status=success&order_id=6aa3fb90b5ae6f6e0b54048e → pack-unlocked appeared on the very first poll (~2.5 s). Post-payment: pack/status returns unlocked:true, last_order.status:'paid'; pack.pdf returns 200 application/pdf, 2 pages (page 1 title 'Maison 120 m² avec garage et terrasse – Soings-en-Sologne' + 'Prix : 250 000 €'; page 2 begins with 'Description'); POST /pack/checkout again → 409 'Pack déjà débloqué pour ce bien'; pack-pdf-button, pack-photos-button, pack-listing-button all visible on the unlocked pack screen. Cancelled scenario tested BEFORE paying at /pack?status=cancelled: pack-cancelled banner ('Paiement annulé. Aucun montant n'a été débité.') visible alongside offer + pay button. Regressions: /api/properties/{pid} still returns the property with estimation intact; GET /api/next-steps 200 with 'properties' key. No red screen and no console errors (only a Cloudflare cf-cache/preload warning on Stripe). NOTE: seed property 6aa02db9efd8f90925a5a758 is now UNLOCKED (paid) as anticipated by the review request.
critical_code_review_comments: pack.py:38 is_unlocked() checks orders with status=='paid'; combined with the 409 in server.py:507, the checkout flow is properly idempotent.

server.py:481 _pack_status calls pack.sync_pending on every status GET — good fallback when webhooks are not configured, and it explains why the frontend saw pack-unlocked on the first ~2.5 s poll after redirect. Consider capping frequency if traffic grows.

pack.py:80 handle_webhook uses Stripe.Webhook.construct_event which requires STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET; not configured in this preview but the polling fallback covers it. If a webhook is ever enabled, the dedupe via db.webhook_events._id=event.id is correct.

pack.tsx:61 uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL for the non-web return_url origin (correct) and window.location.origin on web (correct); return_url is the /pack route so Stripe's success_url picks up ?status=success&order_id=… — verified in production run.
seed_data_creation: One paid Stripe test order was created on property 6aa02db9efd8f90925a5a758 (order_id 6aa3fb90b5ae6f6e0b54048e). The property is now UNLOCKED (as anticipated by the review request). No properties/documents/photos/listings were deleted or modified beyond the pack unlock.
